summary: Constructor/initializer: calls GlobalZeroInit_c2a0, sets this+0x0 to 2 and zeroes this+0x4 through this+0x10, then allocates a 36-byte block via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(36). On success the block is zero-filled and stored at this+0x14; on failure this+0x14 is zero. The this+0x18/0x1C/0x20 dwords are zeroed in both branches. Returns this.

operations.description: Call GlobalZeroInit_c2a0(this) to run the shared zero-initialization helper.
Set the dword at this+0x0 to 2 (a type or version marker).
Set the dword at this+0x4 to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x8 to 0.
Set the dword at this+0xC to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x10 to 0.
Allocate a 36-byte block via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(36); result kept in a local pointer v2.
Branch on v2 != null: allocation success path versus failure path.
On success, zero-fill the 36-byte allocation (nine dwords v2[0] through v2[8]).
On success, store the allocation at this+0x14 (this[5] = v2).
On success, zero the dwords at this+0x18, this+0x1C and this+0x20.
On allocation failure, set this+0x14 to 0.
On allocation failure, zero the dwords at this+0x18, this+0x1C and this+0x20.
Return this as the initialized object.
